kai: Heads-up — found another SDK vs REST parity bug but with enums. REST accepts `consistency_mode: \"strict\"` (lowercase string), our Go/TS SDKs expect enum `Consistency.Strict` (capitalized) and silently map it to default `eventual`. throughput and ordering behaviour changed in the sample app. :thinking_face:
sophie: can you paste a tiny repro? even a minimal payload will help.
kai: yup — REST vs SDK below. REST honored strict and we got strong ordering; SDK ended up using eventual.
kai: ```bash
# REST (respects consistency_mode)
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/write \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" \
  -d '{"stream_id":"s1","payload":"x","consistency_mode":"strict"}'

# TS SDK (enum mismatch -> default eventual)
await client.write({ streamId: 's1', payload: 'x', consistencyMode: Consistency.Strict })
```
qa-bot: quick log check (req=01ZZCONS123): REST request wire payload `{consistency_mode:"strict"}` and server processed strict; SDK wire payload was `{consistency_mode:"eventual"}` in one run.
sophie: hmm. two separate issues: (1) enum serialization / casing parity across REST vs SDKs; (2) retry semantics — sample app retries on 429 but during token refresh storms the control plane returned 503 for short bursts. SDKs treat 503 as retryable while some apps treat it as terminal -> either duplicated writes or lost ordering when app retries. filed a ticket with traces.
kai: opened DEVEX-20222 with the traces and a minimal failing e2e. attached the sampleapp log where ordering diverged.
sophie: plan: (A) implement enum serializer shim in SDKs to map REST string enums to SDK enum values and add unit+integration tests asserting wire parity; (B) unify retry table in the SDK docs and add an option `retryOn503:false` for non-idempotent routes; (C) add a dev-mode strict validator that errors when a passed enum doesn't match known REST values.
kai: also suggestion: add an integration that posts via REST and via SDK and diffs the wire payloads to catch these regressions in CI.
devex-bot: Created ticket DEVEX-20223 from this thread and assigned to @sophie.
sophie: I'll open a small PR to add enum mapping + validation and a sampleapp e2e that verifies no duplicate writes on auth storms. also will add guidance in README about retrying non-idempotent endpoints.
kai: thanks — adding a note to the DEVEX-20222 ticket to coordinate with security on ephemeral token behavior. :white_check_mark:
